extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current patent and trademark practitioners; inventors seeking practitioner help; law students interested in IP clinic experience
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility/administrative standards for individuals who represent others before the USPTO in patent and trademark matters, plus OED programs (pro bono, clinic) and practitioner resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered patent practitioner eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Registered patent practitioners are individuals who have passed the USPTO's registration exam and met the qualifications to represent patent applicants before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OED administers the registration exam and maintains a roster of current patent practitioners. See 'Becoming a patent practitioner' for requirements, forms, and exam information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark practitioner eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Trademark practitioners are attorneys who are active members in good standing of the bar of the highest court of any State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Becoming a trademark practitioner' to learn more about the requirements to represent others in trademark matters before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: OED administration of registration and roster maintenance
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of Enrollment and Discipline (OED) administers the registration exam and maintains a roster of current patent practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OED is the office responsible for registration processes and public rosters of practitioners; related pages include application/registration information and how to find registered practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: OED grievance investigation and disciplinary transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: OED investigates grievances submitted against practitioners and provides public information about disciplinary actions against practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information for current practitioners includes ethics rules, common forms, and online access; public disciplinary information is available via OED.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Pro Bono Program coordination
rubrics_metrics.description: OED coordinates a nationwide Patent Pro Bono Program for under-resourced inventors seeking free legal help.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This program connects inventors who lack resources with volunteer patent practitioners; see the program page for participation and eligibility details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Law School Clinic Certification Program administration
rubrics_metrics.description: OED administers a Law School Clinic Certification Program where law students gain experience in intellectual property law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program certifies law school clinics to permit supervised student practice in IP matters before the USPTO; consult the program page for certification criteria and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding a patent practitioner
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to find registered patent agents and attorneys who are eligible to practice before the USPTO in patent matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The USPTO provides resources to locate eligible practitioners (agents and attorneys); see the 'Finding a patent practitioner' resource for search tools and directories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finding a trademark practitioner
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to find attorneys who practice trademark law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The USPTO offers guidance and resources to locate trademark practitioners; consult the 'Finding a trademark practitioner' page for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information and resources for current practitioners
rubrics_metrics.description: Find useful information for current patent and trademark practitioners including ethics rules, common forms, and online access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Current practitioners should consult these resources for compliance (ethics), procedural forms, and access to USPTO online services; OED is a primary source for practitioner-related administrative matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: OED Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Find answers and general information about OED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The FAQs provide general explanatory material about OED functions, processes, and practitioner-related questions; consult them for quick clarifications.
